questions.explanation: Substitute $y = 2x + 1$ into the second equation: $3x + (2x + 1) = 11$. Simplify: $5x + 1 = 11$, so $5x = 10$, $x = 2$. Then $y = 2(2) + 1 = 5$.

questions.stem: When is the substitution method most convenient?

options.text: When both equations have matching coefficients
When one equation already has a variable as the subject
When the coefficients are all prime numbers

questions.explanation: Substitution is most convenient when one equation is already in the form $y = ...$ or $x = ...$, so you can directly substitute into the other equation.
